description: Four access units of independent substream 0 (3/2 + LFE), a dependent substream with the rear surround pair, and independent substream 1 (2/0).

streams.channel_mode: 3/2 (left, center, right, left surround, right surround)

skip.skip_insertion: ffmpeg decodes only substream 0, so a change to substream 1 would not show.
skip.ffprobe: FFmpeg 8.0's AC-3 parser no longer takes a frame of substream 1 as the start of a packet: its header parser returns an error for any substream ID but 0 (libavcodec/ac3_parser.c, eac3_parse_header: if (hdr->substreamid) return AC3_PARSE_ERROR_FRAME_TYPE), so ac3_sync does not find it and the frame joins the packet before it, whose sample rate and channels the parser then cannot read (0 Hz, 2 channels) and which lists 4 packets for the 8 of the frames. 6.1 listed one packet for each of the two programs; the stream is valid E-AC-3 (ETSI TS 102 366 E.1.2.1 allows substream IDs 0 to 7).
